description: This file contains classes that compile the 'setfilter' and '/setfilter' tags in Smarty template engine, responsible for managing variable filters during template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Setfilter
classes.description: Handles compilation of the 'setfilter' Smarty tag, setting variable filters during template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Setfilterclose
classes.description: Handles compilation of the '/setfilter' Smarty tag, resetting variable filters to previous state.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles code for the respective Smarty tag, modifying variable filter stacks or resetting filters.
